entry.title: Vibe coding a mobile game about vibe coding

media:group.media:title: Vibe coding a mobile game about vibe coding
media:group.media:description:
Solo dev episode #8
I'm making my first mobile game, and it's a game about modern dev life. You play a developer who starts in the family garage, follows the trends and builds apps with an AI coding agent that runs on a token budget, like a real subscription.
This week of my 30-day challenge (one app a week, after Editbay and FocusShell) is a mobile game, made in Unity with Claude. In this episode I play the first version: the character, a build session with a bug-whack round, a launch with a 10% chance of a huge success, the stats row, night energy and the first in-game income.
Editbay: https://github.com/ZazaGdev/editbay FocusShell: https://github.com/ZazaGdev/FocusShell The 30-day challenge: https://zazag.dev/challenges/30-days/
All my links: https://linktr.ee/ZazaGDev

entry.title: How I code in 4 projects at once without losing my mind

media:group.media:title: How I code in 4 projects at once without losing my mind
media:group.media:description:
Solo dev episode #7
FocusShell on GitHub: https://github.com/ZazaGdev/FocusShell
FocusShell is a free, open-source app for managing AI coding agents across multiple projects from one window. One CTO agent reads your task board and hands the work to a lead agent in each project, and this video walks through all of it.
I renamed it from AgentDeck after recording, so you will hear the old name; the on-screen labels show the new one. The video covers setting it up with four demo projects, asking the CTO to pick up work, the coding view with the CTO and four project leads, questions that wait for your answer, the layout, reading files in the app and sketching with Excalidraw. It runs Claude Code sessions in each terminal.
All my links: https://linktr.ee/ZazaGDev

entry.title: Hand-drawn floor plan to editable 3D house

media:group.media:title: Hand-drawn floor plan to editable 3D house
media:group.media:description:
Fun projects #2
Upload a photo of a floor plan, even one drawn with a pen on paper, and get a house you can edit in 2D and 3D. I built a house planner around that one twist and tested it on five real sketches.
The 3D editor is built on the open-source Pascal Editor, and everything it makes stays editable: rescale the whole house from one wall, add furniture and more floors. It still has a lot of small bugs. If you would use it, tell me in the comments and I can open source it.
All my links: https://linktr.ee/ZazaGDev
#solodev #buildinpublic #floorplan
